sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-19b"
sources.quote: WASP-19b, formally named Banksia, is an exoplanet, notable for possessing one of the shortest orbital periods of any known planetary body: 0.79 days or approximately 18.932 hours.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Wattle. Its orbit and size follow Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-19b"
sources.quote: It has a mass close to that of Jupiter, but by comparison has a much larger radius ; making it nearly the size of a low-mass star.
